relevance_note: One cohort patient carries a TNFAIP3 frameshift with individual clinical detail: 'A variant in the tumor necrosis factor, alpha-induced protein (TNFAIP)3 gene (c.997dupG) resulting in a frameshift (p.A333fs^*2) was found in P10'.
method_note: Read the whole paper including the converted supplementary PDF (Tables S1-S5) by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. Scope: of 20 WES-sequenced CVID patients only P10 carries a TNFAIP3 variant (Table 2, text); the other 19 get no rows (cohort_size_as_stated = 20; the clinic has 62 CVID patients and the Danish cohort 179, but the study population is 20). P10's parents are included as relatives because Table S3 row 10, column 'Predispositions' (family history), describes them: 'mother: asthma, thyroiditis. Father: DMII'; their TNFAIP3 status was not tested ('we have not been able to verify whether the variant is de novo or inherited'). Table S3 is a garbled PDF conversion: row 10 spans several lines with columns interleaved; I assigned cells by column order (Pneumococcal antibodies NP, immunization test NP, Predispositions, FEV1 NP, faecal calprotectin 1266, Microbiology 'Sputum: Haemophilus influenzae, Moxarella catarrhalis, VZV, GBS', Referred from 'unknown', Prophylactic AB 'Sulfotrim', IVIG 'Hizentra'). Microbiology (split over six lines) and faecal calprotectin 1266 mg/kg (no reference range printed) were not recorded as features. Lab features from Table 4 were recorded where the value lies outside the reference range printed in the table notes; Table S4 transitional (32.2) and MZ-like (0.4) B cells and Table S5 T-cell subsets were not recorded. Checklist decisions: cytopenia (autoimmune) left 'not reported' because P10's anemia/thrombocytopenia/pancytopenia are not called autoimmune and are linked to hypersplenism, and ITP is excluded by the named group statement (only P17 and P18 had ITP); lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy left 'not reported' because only hepatosplenomegaly/splenomegaly (with portal hypertension) is reported; stomatitis is not counted as oral ulcers; the mother's 'thyroiditis' is not stated to be autoimmune, so autoimmune thyroiditis is 'not reported'. Malignancy and ITP are 'excluded' for P10 from the named group statement in Results (six malignancy patients P1, P6, P12, P17, P5, P4; ITP in P17 and P18). Study inclusion criteria were not used as evidence. Age at diagnosis 23 is from Table 1 ('Age at diagnosis' column, unit not printed; ISO given as years because the cohort ages are stated in years). The text says P10 'was diagnosed with CVID 10 years ago', but no current age is printed, so age at last evaluation is 'not reported' (not computed). Protein variant copied as printed in the Markdown ('p.A333fs^*2'; the caret is a superscript conversion artifact). Zygosity 'heterozygous' for TNFAIP3 rests on the Table 2 title 'Monoallelic variants identified.'; for IL2RG c.-83G>A (Table S2, 'considered unlikely disease-causing') on the Table S2 legend. ethnicity_or_country records cohort membership ('Danish CVID cohort', Aarhus University Hospital), not a stated ancestry. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = true because the paper says the Danish CVID cohort was described before (ref 2) and these patients come from that cohort; no individual-level prior report of P10 is stated. Contradictions noticed (not about P10): P18 PLCG2 CADD score 33 in Table 2 vs 35 in text. No contradictions found for P10.
